color-system.twistDescription: No twist — copied verbatim. Light register: pageBackground #ffffff (brightness=255 > 190).

type-system.twistDescription: Twist B — letter-spacing injection 0.06em on headings and buttons. All proprietary fonts replaced via get-fallback-font: te-20 → Inter (body/paragraph, cold precision-instrument), te-40 → Space Grotesk (headings, geometric industrial). Google Fonts CDN imports only.

motion-system.twistDescription: Twist A — duration scaling ×1.5 (slower, more languid). All durations: 0.3s→0.45s, 0.6s→0.9s, 0.75s→1.125s, 0.9s→1.35s.

grid-system.twistDescription: Twist A — container maxWidth tightened from 1536px to 1306px (−15%, more editorial proportion).

spacing-system.twistDescription: Twist D — button padding shift +12px horizontal (49.5px → 61.5px). More generous button proportions.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Twist E — focus state enhancement: outlineWidth 2px, outlineStyle solid, outlineColor #df5e12 (accent color) added to all interactive elements. No color changes to hover/default states.

nav-system.twistDescription: Twist D — letter-spacing 0.08em added to nav links. fontFamily set to inherit (uses assembled type system). Mubasic (originally picked) had empty geometry; lusion selected as next valid system.
nav-system._note: Original agent-7 pick (mubasic) had empty nav geometry. Fell back to lusion, next system with rich nav data and editorial compatibility.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Twist C — material shift: added specific physical materiality detail to the Background and Section Design Behavior section (off-white surface carrying the tactile memory of uncoated stock). New concept_by_video.md generated for Tallow Press motion brief.

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — all nav/body text pairs have adequate contrast against light backgrounds
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover 0.2-0.3s vs motion 0.9-1.35s (3× ratio, well under 5× threshold)
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav.json uses fontFamily: inherit which references assembled type system
